title: Warm Spanish Gambas Paella
description: Savory seafood paella with creamy corn and a crispy crust. Inspired by Spanish cuisine, this dish is perfect for a dinner party.
instructions: Heat the chicken broth in a saucepan over low heat.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the gambas al ajillo and cook until pink, about 2 minutes.
Add the corn kernels and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir to coat with the oil and mix with the corn and seafood.
Pour in the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, one cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each cup to be absorbed before adding the next. Bring to a simmer.
Transfer the skillet to a preheated oven at 400°F (200°C).
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the top is golden brown and crispy.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with shredded manchego cheese, if using.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
